note.question: What determines many online platforms adopt a price alert mechanism to facilitate customers tracking price changes?
note.overview: Many online platforms adopt a price alert mechanism to facilitate customers tracking price changes. This mechanism allows customers to register their valuation with the system if they find the price higher than their valuation. Once the price drops below the customers’ registered price, a message is sent to notify customers.
